name: Sopater (from Berea)
title: Paul's Traveling Party from Berea
summary: Sopater was a Christian from Berea who joined Paul's traveling party on his third missionary journey. He was the son of Pyrrhus and likely represented the church in Berea when they accompanied Paul with the collection for the poor in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of Paul's Traveling Party
keyEvents.description: Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, was one of the seven men who accompanied Paul on his journey from Macedonia to Syria.

keyEvents.title: Journey to Asia
keyEvents.description: Sopater and the other companions went ahead and waited for Paul in Troas, while Paul himself traveled via Philippi.

keyEvents.title: The Collection for Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: As a representative of the church in Berea, Sopater was likely among those who delivered the churches' gift to the poor Christians in Jerusalem.
